plainTranslation: A total transformation of the Sun person's sense of self, driven by the Pluto person. Magnetic, intense, sometimes a crisis, ultimately a rebuild. Failure mode: power struggles over who the Sun person gets to be - control dressed as devotion. Let the old self go where it needs to, watch for domination, and remember intensity isn't the same as a good fit.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
